abilities.desc_zh: 远程射击注入数据木马，使敌人无法使用特殊技 3 秒，并扰乱其能量条。
abilities.desc_en: Ranged shots inject trojan code, locking opponent Special Attacks for 3s and corrupting their power meter.

abilities.desc_zh: 敌方激活任何增益 (Buff) 时，比特流有 50% 几率将其复制并逆向转化为自身的增益。
abilities.desc_en: Whenever opponent activates a Buff, Bitstream has a 50% chance to copy and invert it into a personal buff.

abilities.desc_zh: 当敌方能量蓄满时，自动触发系统死锁，迫使其流失 50% 能量并眩晕 2 秒。
abilities.desc_en: When opponent power reaches maximum, triggers a Zero-Day system crash, draining 50% power and applying a 2s Stun.

abilities.desc_zh: 注入恶意病毒，使敌人无法施放特殊技持续 {{var_1}} 秒，且在此期间其每次攻击受到反噬 {{var_2}} 伤害。
abilities.desc_en: Injects a malicious virus, locking enemy Specials for {{var_1}} seconds and causing attacks to backlash for {{var_2}} damage.

abilities.desc_zh: 短暂停滞敌方武器控制权，使其陷入瘫痪眩晕 {{var_3}} 秒，并吸取对手 {{var_4}} 能量。
abilities.desc_en: Overrides enemy weapon controls, causing {{var_3}} seconds of Stun and draining {{var_4}} of enemy Power.

abilities.desc_zh: 展开全息网络矩阵格式化敌方核心，施加脑震荡与破甲，降低敌方 {{var_5}} 攻击力与 {{var_6}} 护甲持续 {{var_7}} 秒。
abilities.desc_en: Formats enemy Spark code, inflicting Concussion and Armor Break reducing Attack by {{var_5}} and Armor by {{var_6}} for {{var_7}} seconds.

abilities.desc_zh: 与声波、震荡波同队时，能量获取率提升 {{var_1}}。
abilities.desc_en: +{{var_1}} Power Rate when teamed with Soundwave or Shockwave.

abilities.desc_zh: 与红蜘蛛同队时，获得 +{{var_2}} 破甲。
abilities.desc_en: +{{var_2}} Armor Piercing when paired with Starscream.

abilities.desc_zh: 团队所有低星级队员获得 +{{var_3}} 暴击率。
abilities.desc_en: All lower tier teammates gain +{{var_3}} Critical Rating.
